_comment: Hand-written. One entry per anchor in removed-commands.json; gen-cli-data.mjs fails when an anchor has no path. Value is Markdown.

paths.worktrees: the `@smthrs/time-travel` library, with worktree lanes deferred; see [Time travel](/docs/concepts/time-travel/).
paths.hijack: control a live run with `smthrs steer`, `smthrs signal`, `smthrs approve`, `smthrs deny`, or `smthrs cancel`, and resume a parked one with `smthrs run --resume`; see [Steering runs](/docs/guides/steering/).
paths.pause: `smthrs cancel` ends a run and `smthrs run --resume` resumes a parked one; see [Steering runs](/docs/guides/steering/).
paths.gateway: bare `smthrs gateway` survives as an alias of `smthrs serve`, which hosts the control server for the project; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.ui: `smthrs serve` hosts the control server; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.gui: `smthrs serve` hosts the control server; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.monitor: `smthrs serve` hosts the control server; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.supervise: recovery is owned by the run driver; watch runs with `smthrs ps` and `smthrs status`; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.supervisor: recovery is owned by the run driver; watch runs with `smthrs ps` and `smthrs status`; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.top: recovery is owned by the run driver; watch runs with `smthrs ps` and `smthrs status`; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.supervision: `smthrs run --resume` resumes a parked run, and the run driver owns takeover and recovery; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.chat: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs up`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.chat-create: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs up`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.what: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs up`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.ask: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs up`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.agents: seats resolve from provider environment keys, and `smthrs doctor` reports provider readiness; see [Model seats](/docs/guides/model-seats/) and [Environment variables](/docs/reference/environment-variables/).
paths.observability: the kernel's telemetry and the OTLP layer; see [Observability](/docs/guides/observability/).
paths.cron: no replacement ships in rc.0; cron returns on `@smthrs/triggers`.
paths.share: no replacement ships in rc.0; flows live in the project's own `flows/` directory and move with its version control.
paths.add: no replacement ships in rc.0; flows live in the project's own `flows/` directory.
paths.remove: no replacement ships in rc.0; flows live in the project's own `flows/` directory.
paths.eject: no replacement ships in rc.0; a migrated project already owns every file under `flows/`.
paths.upgrade: `smthrs migrate`; see Plan and apply above.
paths.packs: no replacement ships in rc.0; a 1.0 project keeps flows under `flows/` in version control; see [Project layout](/docs/reference/project-layout/).
paths.workflow: bare `smthrs workflow` is removed too, and `smthrs workflow list` survives as the `ls` alias. `smthrs ls` lists flows, `smthrs up` runs one, and `smthrs doctor` checks readiness; see [Flow discovery](/docs/guides/flow-discovery/).
paths.human: list parked approvals with `smthrs ps --status waiting-approval`, then answer them with `smthrs approve` or `smthrs deny`; see [Human approval](/docs/tutorials/human-approval/).
paths.ask-human: the run parks at the approval; list parked approvals with `smthrs ps --status waiting-approval`, then answer them with `smthrs approve` or `smthrs deny`; see [Human approval](/docs/tutorials/human-approval/).
paths.node: `smthrs output` prints one registered node output and `smthrs logs --json` renders the events; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.tail: `smthrs logs --follow` streams future events and `smthrs output` prints one registered node output; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.test: run the project's own test runner; for testing flows themselves, see [Testing flows](/docs/guides/testing-flows/).
paths.databases: local SQLite; rc.0 has no PostgreSQL or PGlite backend, and `SMITHERS_BACKEND=pglite` or `SMITHERS_BACKEND=postgres` fails the same way, exiting 1 with `unsupported_database`. See [Unsupported database](/docs/troubleshooting/unsupported-database/).
paths.init: the `smthrs init` verb itself stays; seats resolve from provider environment keys; see [Model seats](/docs/guides/model-seats/) and [Environment variables](/docs/reference/environment-variables/).
paths.plan-admission: declare parallelism in the flow and let plan admission bound it; see [Flows, actions, and plans](/docs/concepts/flows-actions-plans/) and [Plan, approve, run](/docs/guides/plan-approve-run/).
paths.flows: This anchor is not a removal. Verbs that take a flow id refuse the reserved `system/*` ids: a reserved system flow id carries no body in 1.0.0-rc.0, so a launch would park with nothing to run. **1.0 path:** name a flow from `smthrs ls`; see [Flow discovery](/docs/guides/flow-discovery/).
